title: Use the Higgsfield Candid Paparazzi preset on Seedance 2 by uploading a photo…

tips: Use the Higgsfield Candid Paparazzi preset on Seedance 2 by uploading a photo and launching the preset to generate an ultra-dynamic, realistic paparazzi-style video.
